scope: Synchronization-granularity diagnosis, not a replacement kernel benchmark or deployment claim
decision: Report all cells and sync1/sync32 sensitivity separately from original/masked/compiled ranking. Do not promote a kernel or claim host-only causality. No tuning after observation.
timing_scope: Host perf_counter includes Python graph construction, eval, GPU work and synchronization. Each sample starts from the same input and performs the same dependent 32 calls; all h/y outputs are forced before their batch is released. Outer chain is not compiled as one function.

profile.scope: One process-attributed trace per arm, including initialization and warmups. Interval counts are not kernel launches; profiler times are not uninstrumented latency.
